answer.reason: The verses tell of Herod the tetrarch's imprisoning and beheading of John and his mocking of Jesus, which go beyond the summary.

clauses.english: imprisoned John for reproving him over Herodias, his brother Philip's wife
clauses.quote: he shut up John in prison

clauses.english: beheaded John after promising Herodias' daughter whatever she asked
mocked Jesus, dressed him in a gorgeous robe and sent him back to Pilate
clauses.quote: Herod with his men of war set him at nought, and mocked him

doubts: MAT 14:1 and MRK 6:14 call him king Herod; taken as the same tetrarch.
MRK 8:15 (leaven of Herod), LUK 8:3 (Chuza, Herod's steward), ACT 4:27 and ACT 13:1 do not clearly say more of his own deeds and were left out.
LUK 13:31 reports only that Herod would kill Jesus; not an event, so left out.
The beheading itself is only stated by Herod's own words (MRK 6:16, LUK 9:9), with the request in MRK 6:24; the order is not in the verses given.
